notes.title: Wildfrost Mod Support Storms In!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/c7618c72f2250636b048ed20af91f17111e5addd.png[/img]

[h3]Hello Snowdwellers![/h3]

Before we get started, A reminder that Wildfrost will be 30% off in Chucklefish’s 13th Anniversary Publisher sale from today at 18:00 BST, so there’s no better time to dive in! Don’t dilly dally, as the sale only runs to July 29!

Last update we announced the final Wildfrost update, well… we lied! We have one more surprise for you, with the help of miya_kope and our wonderful [url=https://discord.gg/zTQxzREp]discord [/url]community, we are excited to announce the game now features official mod support via the Steam workshop!

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1811990/workshop/


Have you ever dreamt of playing Wildfrost with randomized card stats? Googly eyes? Or perhaps adding your own crazy card and charm ideas to the game? Well now you can! The Wildfrost workshop already features over 60 mods created by our amazing community, with many more in the works. 


[h3]How To Play Mods[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Ensure you're updated to v1.2.2 on Steam
[*] Subscribe to the mods you want on Steam Workshop
[*] Select 'Play Wildfrost With Mods' when you launch Wildfrost
[*] Select 'Mods' in the Main Menu
[*] Press the Bell Icon next to the Mod you want to install
[*] PLAY THAT MOD.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/eba89776f308bef46498292138ad2676709fdf50.png[/img]
For an extended guide on how to access and build mods check the [url=https://wildfrostwiki.com/Guide:Modding]wiki[/url], or join the Wildfrost [url=https://discord.gg/zTQxzREp]discord [/url]discord and check out the #modding channel to learn about adding your own! There’s loads of exciting developments going on there but we wanted to highlight one in particular…

[h2]Mod Spotlight: Snowfall[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/1e5878895c7d37d247353f57575cb1f7fea3d144.png[/img]

One of the experiences we want to highlight is Snowfall! It’s a clever mod by a talented team of 5 where you play as the BAD GUYS working their way through to the various biomes in reverse order to take down the Snowdwellers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/098486cdd1490547a4da2d50ff2b1d0da9c6d2bc.png[/img]

‘The Wildfrost is growing more anxious. It knows the adventurers that come to slay its source will never end. There is only one way to ensure the eternal storm...destroying Snowdwell. The Guardian calls upon his minions to storm Snowdwell in retaliation, hoping to bring an end to the last civilization among the snow. Will the Snowdwellers survive the incoming storm? Or will the Wildfrost forever rest upon the land?’

SNOWFALL flips the script and introduces a PLETHORA of new companions, charms, enemies, bosses and items. With companions such as the portly Pebble Hog, or the Spicy Pipper, you’ll no doubt be cooking up new strategies to keep those Snowdwellers snowed under.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/2be23cffc85b5c4e308b3be49e724099a808314b.png[/img]
Your new foes will have absolutely no chill. With entirely new factions developed for you to fight based off the synergy from the playable cards within the base game, there’s so much to love in this mod. The Cleaving Crowers are also a force to be reckoned with! Though they may fight amongst themselves, their strength is fueled by the loss of their fallen comrades. It's fun to see them in action, but be prepared for an intense battle if you cross their path! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/4c990334ca791ee566faa4315c6ea6eccd32e685.png[/img]

There’s plenty more on the way besides Snowfall so keep a keen eye out in the Wildfrost discord for more magical mods.


[h2]Tinkering[/h2]

The Clunkmasters have been tinkering again and this update also comes with additional balance changes and bug fixes! 

[h3]1.2.2[/h3]
[list]
[*] Devicro - Counter reduced to 3
[*] Binku - Health increased to 5
[*] Weevil - Health increased to 60
[*] Snoffel - Health reduced to 3
[*] Snobble - Health increased to 6
[*] Roibos - Health increased to 8, Attack increased to 3
[*] Pimento - Counter reduced to 4
[*] Fixed summoned unit with ink losing health after losing ink
[*] Fixed issues with killing an enemy at the same time as inking them
[*] Fixed Nom & Stompy's effect not working properly when killing multiple enemies at once
[*] Fixed "boost effects" effect not remaining when you quit & reload mid battle
[*] Fixed Mimik sometimes attacking from the wrong row
[*] Fixed some challenges not showing up at the end of the run when they are completed
[*] Fixed "Trigger when an enemy is killed" effect not interrupting Frenzy like Smackback does
[*] Fixed error when there are too many cards in hand
[*] Fixed error when there is too much blood on the battlefield
[*] Fixed scrolling through many charms on gamepad skipping past items
[*] Fixed error from Monch with Yank
[/list]

[h2]Tasty 3D Monch Card Giveaway[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/9fe54f9f10346e5c90549066f8ca2d606f1cb590.jpg[/img]

And last but definitely not least, we’re also running our final competition for a gorgeous Wildfrost card, handmade by the incredibly talented Pierrot Cards. Check out this [url=https://x.com/ChucklefishLTD/status/1815359870670901267]X[/url] post for more info on how to be in with a chance of winning your very own Monch 😋

Thanks once again Snowdweller for all your continued support and dedication to Wildfrost! We couldn’t do this without you! <3

notes.title: Unwrapping 'A Storm is Coming' 1.1.0 Update - Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello Wildfrost aficionados, 'tis the season! 

To celebrate the holidays, we're excited to present [b]our biggest update for Wildfrost ye[/b]t. Loaded with powder-fresh features, balance adjustments, and bug fixes. This wouldn't have been possible without our dedicated beta participants opting in and giving us so much feedback to improve the game – you're our true MVPs! With that said, let's dive right in...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/84db4024ae4a66f6522342c57b1bfeb7e984eaf2.png[/img]
In an effort to balance the gameplay, we've lessened the base game difficulty by eliminating aspects like Companion Injuries. The challenge, however, returns (with a vengeance) in our all-new Storm Bell difficulty system! We’ve added 13 unique Storm Bells, each bringing forth its own set of trials; you'll face reduced enemy wave bell encounters, increased shop and Crown prices, even more charm-holding enemies, and a whole bunch of cursed crowns and charms for extra measure.

Each Storm Bell carries a point value, allowing you to handpick the level of challenge you wish to face, and to take on the True Final Boss™, you'll need to amass a certain number of points. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/2f278bc166cefe91045f96d329705a56befb9cb6.png[/img]
But wait, there’s more! Vanquishes with Storm Bells activated will now unlock glorious Gold card frames to mark your victory, as well as Chiseled frames for those normal wins. We've also rejigged the Daily Voyage, bringing in a random mix of Storm Bells for a more unpredictable challenge. And for those who have been requesting a less flashy gameplay experience, we've added an option to disable the Snow Screen transition in the settings menu.

We’ve also made a whole bunch of balances changes and mechanical updates to cards across the tribe pools for you to check out and let us know what you think.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/48b0462d59981f8b2368177bcf61584319c916f9.png[/img]

We recommend looking over the entire changelist found on the [url=https://wildfrostwiki.com/Version_History][b]Official Wildfrost Wiki[/b][/url] in your own time, as it’s such an extensive update.

That’s all for the moment! Please do let us know what you think either in the comments here, the steam forums or over on Discord where you can also see what we’re up to 👀

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Storm Bells BETA
notes.notes:
Ahoy, Wildfrost Adventurers!

We're back! Will and Gaziter have been working to address various issues and *also*, to bring some challenging new content to Wildfrost for all those veterans looking for even more hardship to sink their teeth into.

Let's dive right into the details.

[h2]Version 1.0.7[/h2]

This update primarily focuses on squashing bugs and refining your gameplay experience. Here are the key changes:

[list]
[*] Sorted out the Haze + Smackback issue. No more unexpected surprises!
[*] Fixed the elusive Haze icon in the battle log - it will now appear as expected.
[*] Resolved the error that occurred when using a Barrage Blank Mask.
[*] Frenzy no longer breaks for the remainder of the battle after attacking a Smackback Apply Snow enemy.
[*] Fixed the overlapping of cards when having 6 Companions.
[*] Charm Merchant will now behave properly on touch screens, no more instant buying of charms!
[*] Last but not least, we've optimized the game for 3:2 aspect ratios, ensuring a better visual experience for players.
[/list]

[h2]Version 1.0.8 Beta[/h2]

The next update will bring a twist to the gameplay, all set to go into beta testing. We're introducing new features that will test your strategy and survival skills with all new additional bells and cursed charms 👻

[list]
[*] We’re aiming to reduce the base difficulty by removing things like Companion Injuries and adding that challenge back into the game in the form of Storm Bells.
[*] There are 12 Storm Bells in total to be unlocked, each adding a unique challenge to take your gameplay to the next level. Some add Cursed Charms that you must pick up after each Boss Battle, while others beef up enemies’ abilities.
[*] Each Storm Bell has a point value. You can pick & choose which Storm Bells you want to enable, but you’ll need to have a certain number of points if you want to face off against the True Final Boss.
[/list]

...Please note that opting into beta replicates your current save file so you'll have access to your main branch unlocks. However, progress made during this beta may not carry over when 1.0.8 launches proper, and opting out will revert back to your 1.0.7 save.


[b]To opt-in:[/b]
- right click the game in your Steam Library
- select Properties...
- select the Betas tab
- click the Beta Participation dropdown and select the "beta" branch

We're excited to see how these updates enhance your Wildfrost experience! As always, your feedback is invaluable and we encourage you to share your experiences and suggestions as we continue to refine and improve the game. Please feel free to drop comments below or join our brilliant community over on Discord. Happy gaming! 🃏🌨️

notes.title: 1.0.6 'A Better Adventure' OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey folks! 

Firstly, a huge thank you to all the players who opted into the beta and shared their feedback about what worked, what didn’t and what could use more attention. We’ve managed to refine the build and we’re excited to share the official 1.0.6 public update with you all. Here are all the changes…

[*] New Leader screen:
   -  Before starting a run, there’s now the option to choose a tribe, then be presented with a choice of 3 leaders from that tribe.
   -  Adjusted and added some leader effects
   -  Overhauled graphics 
[*]  New Sun Vault reward after defeating a boss: Choose 2 rewards from a randomized collection of sun bells, charms and a crown.
[*]  New Sun Bells
   - Sun Bell of Health - Leader health +6
   - Sun Bell of Time - Enemy Wave Bell Counter +1
   - Sun Bell of Recall - Recalling a Companion will count down the Redraw Bell by 2
   - Sun Bell of Charge - Start each Battle with the Redraw Bell fully Charged
   - Sun Bell of Fellowship companion limit increase to +2
[*]  New Enemy wave bell:
    - Enemy waves no longer automatically deploy.
    - Wave Bell can be hit to call the next wave of enemies early. This can be useful for setting up bigger combos, hitting more enemies with things like Pombomb, I.C.G.M, keeping Shroom on the board with the Fungo Blaster, etc.
[*]  Crowns in shops get more expensive each time you buy one
[*]  Enemies drop more blings & Kill Combos give less blings
[*]  Gnome Traveller event changes:
    - Can now contain cards from ALL Tribes
    - Only 2 of the 3 cards from the Gnome Traveller will come with Junk
    - Now shows which cards come with Junk
[*]  New Injured Companion event: gain an injured companion from your previous run
[*]  Positive effects removed from Frost Bells (this is a temporary change as the next update will include a whole new Frost Bell system)
[*]  Unit targets: when hovered over, cards active in battle now show a target of where they would attack. This can be toggled on and off in the settings.
[*]  Charm Changes:
  - Cards now show which charms they hold when inspected
  - Enemies can no longer hold 2 of the same charm in a battle
  - Added more charm options for enemies
  - Bite Charm now gives 3 Teeth instead of 4
[*]  Cards now show a flag of the tribe pool they belong to when inspected
[*]  Mega Mimik now only triggers when ally in row attacks

[b]The Enemy Wave Bell:[/b]
Players can ring the enemy wave bell to call the next wave of enemies early. Enemies will now no longer auto-deploy when the board is cleared.
This change will allow new players to focus on each wave at a time without getting overwhelmed by new enemies, and have a breathing room before each wave to deploy new cards/buff up companions. [u][b]Gameplay Tips[/b][/u]
[b]In Battle:
[/b][list]
[*] Cards auto-attack in Wildfrost when placed on the battlefield once their ‘counter’ reaches zero/0. Different cards will have different counters, and you can strategically manipulate both your own and enemy card counters by delaying or speeding them up with special items.
[*] You can also move cards around on rows to target different enemies (a standard card with no modifiers such as ‘barrage’ will auto-hit the card in the front opposite row)
 
[*] Hover over any card for more info & right-click to see a full card overview - especially handy for boss battles to learn more about their modifiers and base stats!
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/673f8b3d7361b9eee715fae5de45b318bcc0cdc3.png[/img]

notes.title: Wildfrost review: cute, compelling, and chaotic card battling
notes.notes:
Wildfrost is excellent at creating moments of triumph. Early on in my playthrough while I was still getting to grips with the game, I came face-to-face with a boss who got stronger when hit. Its card art had become bigger, juicier, more tauntingly malevolent, and easily could have taken out any of my team with a single hit. Thankfully, three of my team members were due to act one turn before it. The first chipped away a little of its health (its job was mostly healing) but the next doubled a stacked debuff that I had set up and turned the goliath into a giant bomb, and the effect of my two cards combined was just enough to trigger it. BOOM! My backline leader didn't even need to lift a single finger.

Playing with turn order and setting up synergies is a key part of how Wildfrost plays as a roguelike deck builder. Each individual card on the stage is part of a counter system, with both delaying and advancing them on the playing field being strategic choices. Some actions are free, like moving your cards around the stage or withdrawing them for healing, but playing cards out of your hand or shuffling your deck will pass the turn.

notes.title: Wildfrost Dev Update: 2023 Release with Cool New Features
notes.notes:
Hey everybody,

First of all we would like to give a huge thank you to everyone who downloaded, played, streamed, and shared their feedback for Wildfrost’s Steam Next Fest demo! The support from players has been so incredible, and we’re working on making the game the coolest it can be for launch.

Until then, we wanted to let you know what we’ve been working on since, and how your feedback has helped shape the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/2f1103607c9a763d571c8863a155ca53504c9d58.png[/img]
[i]Sneak peek at a snobun[/i]

[h3]Hard Mode?[/h3]
We recognise that the demo difficulty wasn’t for everyone, so we’ve taken it down a notch for people who want to enjoy their time frolicking up the mountains, and we will be adding challenge modes for those of you looking for interesting ways to make things more s̾p̾i̾c̾y̾.

[h3]The Woolly Snail Shop[/h3]
Lots of players pointed out that they had accidentally purchased the crown when attempting to inspect it. This is now changed, so you should be able to view items in the shop without spending your hard-earned blings!

[h3]Snow Immunity Changes[/h3]
Snow immunity is now snow resistance. Bosses and minibosses will no longer be completely immune to snow, but instead they’ll have a 1-turn resistance timer meaning that multipliers of snow do not work, but you can still snow them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/4b4d38610ad2d97b183b6787e98ce81458349152.png[/img]

[h3]Daily Runs[/h3]
Exactly what it says on the tin; we’ve introduced a fixed set of cards and enemies for everyone to tackle. A new challenge every day will be available every day for you to battle your way up those leaderboards.

[h3]Player statistics[/h3]
Player stats coming! 

[h3]More Map Events [/h3]
In addition to the Treasure Chests, Blingsnail Caves, The Woolly Snail shop, frozen travellers and charm gashapons you came across in the demo version, you’ll also find more treasure and quirky strangers with too-good-to-refuse offers along the route in the full game! 

[h3]Boss Rewards[/h3]
After each boss battle you’ll get to pick from an array of perks such as +1 companion on the field or -1 to the redraw bell counter, to bolster your deck and increase your chances of taking down the enemies that await.

[h3]Release Window[/h3]
We’re still implementing, balance testing and playing with new features, new cards and more fun ways to play, so please bear with us as we make these tweaks ready for launch. 
With that being said, we want to update everybody to let you know that we’ve made the decision to push the [b]release to early 2023[/b] (still Winter!) so that we can bring you these new features. Our goal is always to make the coolest game we can, and we’ve been able to make the next steps towards that goal thanks to everyone who gave feedback.  

[h3]Now for some fun stats! [/h3]
[list]
[*] The most popular companion pick was Big Berry, however Naked Gnome gets a special mention as over 85% of you kept him around after sparing him
[*] The least popular companion pick was Blunky *whomp whomp*. Maybe some of you will adopt him in the full game
[*] The most popular clunker by a large margin was the Mobile Campfire - not just picked the most, but also had the highest win rate 
[*] Players found the Spice Monkeys the most difficult to overcome and the Snowbos the easiest to defeat
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/ac422e931e35f84e90d0a51bfbee46e24d6dae5e.gif[/img]
[i]Check out this fun fella[/i]

That about wraps it up! If you enjoyed the demo, and want to find out more about Wildfrost before launch, come chat to us on [url=https://twitter.com/wildfrostgame]Twitter[/url] or on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/wildfrost]official Discord[/url]! There you’ll find teasers for new card designs, can see what we’re are working on, and chat about cheese 🧀. Finally, be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811990/Wildfrost/]wishlist the game[/url] for a notification when the full game drops.

Stay frosty!

notes.title: Announcing Wildfrost - a tactical roguelike deckbuilder!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We’re incredibly excited to reveal [b]Wildfrost[/b], a single-player roguelike card game set in a frosty world. 

The team here at Chucklefish have already been sinking hundreds of hours into Wildfrost’s equally charming and challenging runs [strike](especially one very addicted team member!)[/strike], so we can’t wait for you all to get swept up in the snowstorm later this year ❄

Check out the trailer we just revealed as part of Nintendo’s Indie World Showcase:

[previewyoutube=AAcgJJpl_Jw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What’s it all about then?[/h2]
In Wildfrost the world has plunged into a deep winter - even the Sun has frozen over! With each run, you’ll be battling monsters you encounter along the path to reach the Sun Temple, in an attempt to banish the frost once and for all!

Before heading out across Wildfrost’s unforgiving frozen tundra, you’ll need to choose your Leader and a starting pet. Leaders are randomly generated with different skills and stats and, depending on which tribe they belong to, will provide you with a different starting deck of cards. As you progress through the game, you’ll unlock more decks from different tribes to experiment with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/4f8cc9d6b80042b9f1dfb99ad36b743500b88a84.gif[/img]

Making it all the way to the Sun Temple won’t be easy though… To truly defeat the everlasting frost you’ll need to rescue and recruit frozen card companions, building a deck strong enough to withstand waves of deceptively cute monsters. Savvy adventurers plot out the best route through the snowy wilderness to stop off at travelling merchants and uncover lost treasures along the way. 

You can upgrade and customise your favourite cards throughout your journey using special wobbly charms to enhance their powers or unlock other boons. Return to the survivor stronghold of Snowdwell between runs to expand the town with new buildings, opening up shops to unlock new cards, tribes, events, customisation options, daily runs and challenges. The more you rebuild Snowdwell, the more options you’ll have to take down the brutish monsters that block your path. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/2676caf0a049f758386cb3e797d167cb0583560d.gif[/img]

When you’re facing up against a particularly tough group of enemies you’ll need to harness all of your strategic skills to come out on top during a card battle. By customising your deck, experimenting with different elemental card combinations, and mastering the ‘counter’ system to your strategic advantage, you might just have a chance! 

[i](We’ll get more into the nitty-gritty details of that counter system in a future dev blog!)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/b2fc94f2462f5205993204ea0d187b0a8a3ea881.gif[/img]

[h2]Who is making it?[/h2]
Wildfrost is being made by developer duo [url=https://twitter.com/onegamewill]Will Lewis[/url] (Programmer & Designer, Deadpan Games) and [url=https://twitter.com/Gaziter]Gaziter[/url] (Artist & Designer)! Will previously developed the brutal roguelike platformer [i]Caveblazers[/i], while Gaziter has produced incredible art for cosy indie games [i]Forager[/i] and [i]KnotBot[/i]. 

The core team have been working together remotely on the project since March 2020, when it was originally a prototype Gaziter had been experimenting with made out of paper! By September 2020, the prototype had expanded enough to begin full development and become the beautifully charming deck-builder you see today!

[h2]What languages will Wildfrost be playable in?[/h2]
At the moment we can initially confirm Wildfrost will be playable in English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. 

If your language isn’t listed above, the best way to let us know you’re interested is by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811990/Wildfrost/]wishlisting[/url] - we will be closely watching wishlist data to evaluate which languages the community is most interested in! Big thanks to our fantastic partners at Kakehashi, Bada Games, and Netease who are working on the current game translations. We hope to bring you more info on localisation soon. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811990/Wildfrost/

[h2]When is it coming out?[/h2]
Wildfrost is currently in development for PC and Nintendo Switch, and we’re aiming (all being well) to release Winter this year! As usual, we will be posting development updates as the game progresses via [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811990/Wildfrost/]Wildfrost's Steam News channel[/url], so keep your eyes peeled for more information!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375445/84f32bd4b4b08457ca16b6652ed8a85749cd05e3.gif[/img]

That’s all for now! If you’d like to keep up to date with more Wildfrost info, [url=http://discord.gg/wildfrost]join the Discord[/url] to chat with the developers, give [url=https://twitter.com/WildfrostGame]@WildfrostGame[/url] a follow on Twitter, or join the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/wildfrostgame/]Wildfrost subreddit[/url]. Lastly, be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811990/Wildfrost/]wishlist the game[/url] to be notified as soon as it drops!

Until next time.

-Chucklefish

P.S. We’re so glad we can also finally reveal to the world the Chucklefish team’s latest obsession - your new favourite card companion - [b]NAKED GNOME[/b].
